description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity demonstrating the use of the Action Bar and options menu, including menu creation, item addition, and handling item selection.

classes.name: ActionBarMechanics
classes.description: An Android Activity showing how to implement and handle an Action Bar with menu items, including their display and selection behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and requests the Action Bar feature before setting the content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with a normal item and an action button with an icon, setting display preferences.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles the selection of menu items, showing a toast with the selected item's title.
